parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under an Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/ directory — a canonical sample-app location per the decision rules. Even though the is_sample_app flag reads false, the file path is dispositive. The duplicate 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.init' in DebugHUD.swift is a deliberate local re-implementation for the demo HUD, not an accidental copy. Extracting it into a shared location would couple the Wallpaper sample app's debug tooling to the DebugPanel production package, which is precisely the coupling the sample-app-mirror restraint is designed to prevent.
